basic_info.description: This top floor, view condo is centrally located at the border of vibrant Hayes Valley & Civic center. It boasts a 98 Walk score & a 100 Transit score. Enjoy expansive Western views from all rooms, including South SF, Twin Peaks & Sutro Tower, Buena Vista Park, Alamo Square, Jefferson Square & the Cathedral of St Mary. A smartly executed floor plan provides two en suite bedrooms, both nicely separated by a large living/dining room combination. Both bedrooms have dual pane windows & are large enough for king beds. The spacious & light filled living/dining area has high ceilings, tall windows, wood floors, a wood burning fireplace, & direct access to a deeded balcony. The kitchen provides abundant cabinet space, stainless steel appliances, & new granite countertops. The primary BR has high ceilings, a large closet & direct access to the balcony. The condo has radiant heat & an in-unit washer & dryer. There's also deeded parking, an elevator & a secure storage room. Enjoy a level walk to the numerous restaurants & boutiques that Hayes Valley has to offer, including the new Trader Joe's at Fulton/ Laguna. Walk to the symphony, opera, ballet & the SF Jazz organization. And at the end of each day, take in lovely sunsets from every room of your spacious top floor condo.
